about: Stable identifiers (n31c, 18 Nov 2026). developers: an alias slug (the same company recorded under another spelling of its name) -> the one stable developer id; named.py publishes every project of an alias under the stable id, and the site answers the alias page with a 301 to it. projects: a record merged into another one (the same project recorded twice; the duplicate keeps its place in projects-world.json with merged_into, so no other public id moves) -> the slug of the record kept; the site answers the old page with a 301. A pair joins this file only when the same legal company or the same project is shown by the sources held (same website or the same registered name with or without its legal suffix).
